# Alert

A message that stays on the page with the content it is about.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Content first</span></p>

## When to use it

**In Content first:** A note or warning inside an article.

- **Use it when:** People need to read a standing notice or how to recover, on this page, tied to what they are doing.
- **Not when:** A short confirmation that can go away by itself, or one notice for the whole site.

Instead:

- [Toast](./toast.md): Short, non-blocking, goes away.
- [Dialog](./dialog.md): Needs an answer before going on.
- Site banner: One full-width notice for the whole site.

## How Content first uses it

<div class="odv-grid two"><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">An error message</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> color.status.danger and a plain sentence</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> Color alone</div></div><div class="cap">The sentence says what to fix; color only draws the eye.</div></div></div>

## Why it works this way

Alert looks the way it does because of 3 answers about this product. Each card is one answer, in three steps: the answer, what it decided for Alert, and what would move if it changed.

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-content-q1"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>What is the main content?</b><code>content.q1</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Long-form text</div><p>The content is long-form text.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Alert</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>default</b>: A note or a warning inside an article.</span></li></ul></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">2</div><small>Alert decisions would reopen</small><p>and 39 answers that follow from it: <b>One idea at a time</b>, <b>Read start to end</b>, <b>Rarely</b>, and 36 more.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-accessibility-count"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>How many signals carry each meaning?</b><code>accessibility.count</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Two: color and word</div><p>Status is rare; color and a word are enough.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Alert</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>destructive</b>: A failed save or sign-up: calm, take the blame, offer the way forward.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Badge: neutral</code> <code>Badge: info</code> <code>Badge: success</code> <code>Badge: warning</code> <code>Badge: danger</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Alert decision would reopen</small><p>No other answer follows from it.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-voice-count"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>How many tones does it use?</b><code>voice.count</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">One per moment</div><p>Warm by default, calmer for errors.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Alert</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>destructive</b>: A failed save or sign-up: calm, take the blame, offer the way forward.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Toast: danger</code> <code>Badge: danger</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Alert decision would reopen</small><p>No other answer follows from it.</p></div></div></section>

## Words

- Write to one person: "you", not "users".
- Short sentences with room to breathe.
- Explain why before asking for anything.
- Use: Read, Save for later, You, Next issue. Avoid: Click here, Submit, Users, Content.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Browse guides

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

Test before you ship:

- [ ] An error that appears after an action is announced (role alert); a standing note is not. undefined
- [ ] The tone also shows as an icon and words, never color alone. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add alert
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.
